description: A narrow, scarred arena. Used for two pivotal events: (1) Karna's Final Duel — Arjuna vs. Karna. Must include a CHARIOT_MUD_TRAP tile cluster near Karna's spawn (Karna's cursed wheel sinks into the mud). (2) The Fall of the Patriarch — Bhishma's bed of arrows. Dual-use map.

tile_overrides.note: Karna's wheel sinks here. When CHARIOTEER with vijaya-wielder enters this tile, triggers seq_wheel_stuck. Karna loses chariot movement for remaining turns.
The point of maximum dramatic tension. VNScene triggers when both Arjuna and Karna stand adjacent to this tile.

KAURAVA.note: Karna spawns near the MUD cluster at (8-9, 7-8).

directive_notes.trigger: trigger-wheel-stuck fires seq_wheel_stuck when karna HP < 30%
directive_notes.note: When Karna dismounts to lift his wheel (wheel_stuck trigger), he cannot attack for 1 turn. This is the window. Arjuna's decision to strike an unarmed man is a Dharma crisis moment.
